-- re-allocated — once per level above it: O(arms²) line copies for one chain.
-- Threading the depth and padding ONCE collapses that to one copy per line.  The
-- emitted text is unchanged: `indentBy d` is by construction `indent` iterated d
-- times, and `indentBy 0` is the identity.
indentBy : Int -> List String -> List String
indentBy d lines =
  let pad = indentPad d
  map (pad ++ _) lines

indentPad : Int -> String
indentPad d = joinWith "" (replicate d "    ")

gname : String -> String
-- A user identifier that is LITERALLY one of the codety ABI param names (`$self` /
-- `$args`, emitted as `(param ...)` on every lifted lambda / wrapper / extern-eta)
-- would collide with that param when it also becomes a `(local ...)` in the same body
-- → wasm-tools "duplicate local identifier".  Escape just those two reserved words so
-- the user var renders distinctly; consistent here means decl + local.get + local.set
-- (all routed through gname) stay in agreement.  Top-level fn/global names also flow
-- through gname, but a user binding named `self`/`args` is equally safe to rename there.
gname "self" = "u__self"
gname "args" = "u__args"
gname n =
  -- The `__wparg<digits>` family is reserved for synthetic positional fn params
  -- (synthParams).  A source var spelled identically would collide with a sibling
  -- positional param's wasm local — escape it so user vars stay distinct.
  if startsWith "__wparg" n && allDigitsFrom (stringToChars n) 7 then
    "u__" ++ n
  else
    n

notIn : List String -> String -> Bool
notIn xs x = not (contains x xs)

-- perf #382: dedup a String list keeping FIRST-seen order.  A `contains x acc`
-- membership test is O(kept) per element ⇒ O(k²), and `dedupKeep` is called ~20× across
-- emit (locals/free-var/num-poly/impl-value-use collection) — several on lists that grow
-- with program size, so the quadratic surfaced as superlinear wasm-emit OP counts on
-- dispatch-heavy code.  An OrdMap seen-set makes membership O(log k); `acc` still carries
-- the reversed first-seen order, so the deduped list is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the old result.
dedupKeep : List String -> List String
dedupKeep xs = reverseL (dedupGo xs omEmpty [])

dedupGo : List String -> OrdMap Unit -> List String -> List String
dedupGo [] _ acc = acc
dedupGo (x :: xs) seen acc =
  if omHasKey x seen then
    dedupGo xs seen acc
  else
    dedupGo xs (omInsert x () seen) (x :: acc)

fst : (a, b) -> a
fst (x, _) = x

sndPair : (String, String) -> String
sndPair (_, y) = y

isSome : Option a -> Bool
isSome (Some _) = True
isSome None = False

-- inclusive-exclusive integer range [lo, hi) as a list.
rangeList : Int -> Int -> List Int
rangeList lo hi = if lo >= hi then [] else lo :: rangeList (lo + 1) hi

tailList : List a -> List a
tailList [] = []
tailList (_ :: xs) = xs

nthArm : List CArm -> Int -> Option CArm
nthArm [] _ = None
nthArm (a :: rest) i = if i == 0 then Some a else nthArm rest (i - 1)

-- a readable tag for the unsupported-node gap message.
ctag : CExpr -> String
ctag (CApp _ _ _) = "CApp (application)"
ctag (CLam _ _) = "CLam (lambda — W4)"
ctag (CMatch _ _) = "CMatch (ordered-arm match — needs the decision-tree form)"
ctag (CDecision _ _ _) = "CDecision (match)"
ctag (CTuple _) = "CTuple (W7)"
ctag (CList _) = "CList (W7)"
ctag (CArray _) = "CArray (W7)"
ctag (CRecord _ _) = "CRecord (W7)"
ctag (CFieldAccess _ _ _ _) = "CFieldAccess (W7)"
ctag (CRecordUpdate _ _ _) = "CRecordUpdate (W7)"
ctag (CVariantUpdate _ _ _) = "CVariantUpdate (W7)"
ctag (CRangeList _ _ _) = "CRangeList (W7)"
ctag (CRangeArray _ _ _) = "CRangeArray (W7)"
ctag (CIndex _ _) = "CIndex (W7)"
ctag (CSlice _ _ _ _) = "CSlice (W7)"
ctag (CMethod _ _) = "CMethod (dispatch — W5)"
ctag (CDict _ _) = "CDict (dispatch — W5)"
ctag (CLetGroup _ _) = "CLetGroup (where/let-group — W4)"
ctag _ = "?"

-- a readable tag for an unsupported pattern.
ptag : Pat -> String
ptag (PVar _ _ _) = "PVar"
ptag PWild = "PWild"
ptag (PLit (LInt _)) = "PLit-LInt"
ptag (PLit (LFloat _)) = "PLit-LFloat"
ptag (PLit (LString _)) = "PLit-LString"
ptag (PLit (LChar _)) = "PLit-LChar"
ptag (PLit (LBool _)) = "PLit-LBool"
ptag (PLit LUnit) = "PLit-LUnit"
ptag (PCon _ _) = "PCon"
ptag (PTuple _) = "PTuple (W7)"
ptag (PCons _ _) = "PCons (list — W7)"
ptag (PList _) = "PList (list — W7)"
ptag (PAs _ _ _ _) = "PAs"
-- #380 (first half): without this arm a range-shaped residual gap fell to `_ = "?"` and
-- named no construct — which is why the #379 ledger rows read `… literal): ?`.
ptag (PRng _ _ _) = "PRng"
ptag _ = "?"

-- the W3 scope wall: any out-of-slice node lands here (an explicit hard stop).
gap : String -> a
gap msg = panic ("wasm_emit gap — " ++ msg)

plannedValBinds : EmitPlan -> List CBind -> List CBind
plannedValBinds plan groups =
  let binds = bindNameMap groups
  map
    (n => match omLookup n binds
      Some b => b
      None => panic ("internal error: global init: membership: " ++ n))
    plan.globalInit.eagerOrder

runtimeNameW : Prog -> String -> String
runtimeNameW prog symbol =
  optionOr "" (externRuntimeKey (progEmit prog).externFacts symbol)

externDisplayW : WasmEmit -> String -> String
externDisplayW emit symbol = match omLookup symbol emit.externFacts
  Some fact => fact.declaredName
  None => symbol

hasFamilyW : Prog -> String -> String -> Bool
hasFamilyW prog symbol tag =
  match (lookupAssoc
    (runtimeNameW prog symbol)
    (emitDemandW (progEmit prog)).catalogFamilies)
    Some family => WD.wasmFamilyTag family == tag
    None => False
